name: v4_buyback_quality_subindustry
hypothesis: The buyback+quality branch worked; changing the comparison group to subindustry may improve peer comparability without changing the core mechanism.
notes: Controlled variant of MPpGzqwr; correlation gate should reject if too similar.

name: v4_repurchased_shares_quality
hypothesis: Number of shares repurchased can provide a different payout lens than cash payments; combine with quality to avoid weak firms.
notes: Alternative buyback intensity field; sparse but economically direct.

name: v4_dividend_yield_quality
hypothesis: Dividend yield plus operating quality may capture shareholder yield with less sparsity than buyback-only fields.
expression: 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(dividend / close, 126), industry) + 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Payout branch but different from buyback; check for value/quality correlation.

name: v4_news_earnings_sentiment_slow
hypothesis: The news earnings sentiment branch had Sharpe but weak Fitness; longer smoothing and higher decay may reduce turnover enough to become submit-worthy.
notes: Low-turnover repair of v3 news quality candidate.
